pages.body:
Why This Book Exists


Have you ever looked at a code? Maybe a secret code. Maybe a cipher. Maybe a puzzle. It looks like random letters. It looks like random numbers. It looks like nonsense. But then you find the key. You decode it. You see the message. You see the meaning. You see the truth.


The book of Genesis is a code. It is not a secret code. It is not a hidden code. But it is a code. It is a book of beginnings. It is a book of stories. It is a book of symbols. And every symbol points to something. Every story points to someone. Every beginning points to a new beginning. That someone is Jesus. That new beginning is in Him.


This book is for the curious. It is for the spiritual seeker who wants to decode the ancient text. It is for the person who wants to find the spiritual truths. Over the next 30 days, we are going to look at 30 symbols in Genesis. We are going to decode them. We are going to see what they mean. We are going to see who they point to. And we are going to find the spiritual truths of Christ in the book of beginnings.


The Value You Will Get


By the end of this book, you will not see Genesis as just a collection of stories. You will see it as a book of symbols. You will see it as a book of truths. You will see it as a book of Christ. You will understand the symbols. You will understand the truths. You will understand why the book of beginnings matters today. You will have a new confidence in your faith. You will have a new love for your Bible. And you will have a new appreciation for the spiritual truths of Christ.


How to Use This Guide

pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a code? Have you ever seen a cipher? Have you ever seen a puzzle? The book of Genesis is a code. It is a puzzle. It is a cipher. And the first symbol is creation. It is the first code. It is the first truth. It is the first clue. And it points to Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth." - Genesis 1:1 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


This is the first verse in the Bible. It is the first symbol. It is the first code. God created everything. He created the heavens. He created the earth. He created the stage. He created the setting. He created the world where the story would happen.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. He was with God in the beginning. Through him all things were made; without him nothing was made that has been made." - John 1:1-3


The Gospel of John opens with the same words as Genesis. "In the beginning." But John reveals the Word. The Word was with God. The Word was God. The Word is Jesus. Jesus was there in the beginning. He was the creator. He was the code.


The Verdict
The code of creation is Jesus. The pattern is exact. The code is precise. The truth is Jesus.


The Resonance
Do you ever feel like your life is random? Do you ever feel like there is no plan? Remember the code. Remember the creator. God created everything with a plan. He created you with a plan. You are not an accident. You are part of the code.


The Prayer
God, thank you for the code. Thank you for the plan. Thank you that you created everything with a purpose. Thank you that you created me with a purpose. Thank you that Jesus was there in the beginning. Help me to see your plan in my life. Help me to trust your code. Amen.

The Hook
Have you ever seen a code in the light? Have you ever seen a code in the darkness? The book of Genesis starts with darkness. It starts with a void. It starts with an empty canvas. And then God speaks. And light appears. And the light is a code. It is a symbol. It is a truth. And it points to Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"And God said, 'Let there be light,' and there was light." - Genesis 1:3 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was over the surface of the deep. The Spirit of God was hovering over the waters. And God said, "Let there be light." And there was light. God spoke. And light came. It was the first command. It was the first creation. It was the first step in the code.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life." - John 8:12


Jesus is the light. He is the one who shines in the darkness. He is the one who dispels the void. He is the one who brings life. The light in Genesis is a shadow. It is a clue. It is a code. The reality is Jesus.


The Verdict
The code of light is Jesus. The pattern is exact. The code is precise. The truth is Jesus.


The Resonance
Do you feel like you are in darkness? Do you feel like you are in a void? Do you feel like you are empty? Remember the light. God spoke light into the darkness. He can speak light into your darkness. He can speak life into your void. He can speak Jesus into your emptiness.


The Prayer
Jesus, you are the light of the world. Thank you for shining in the darkness. Thank you for dispelling the void. Thank you for bringing life. Shine your light into my heart today. Shine your light into my darkness. Help me to follow you. Help me to walk in your light. Amen.

Jesus is the God of order. He is the God of peace. He brings structure to chaos. He brings calm to the storm. He brings peace to the heart. The order in Genesis is a shadow. It is a clue. It is a code. The reality is Jesus.


The Verdict
The code of order is Jesus. The pattern is exact. The code is precise. The truth is Jesus.


The Resonance
Do you feel like your life is chaotic? Do you feel like your life is a mess? Do you feel like you have extra pieces and no instructions? Remember the God of order. He can bring order to your chaos. He can bring peace to your storm. He can bring structure to your void.


The Prayer
Jesus, you are the God of order. Thank you for bringing order out of chaos. Thank you for bringing peace to my storm. Thank you for bringing structure to my void. Bring order to my life today. Bring peace to my heart. Help me to trust your code. Amen.

The Ancient Text (OT)
"By the seventh day God had finished the work he had been doing; so on the seventh day he rested from all his work. Then God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it he rested from all the work of creating that he had done." - Genesis 2:2-3 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God created for six days. He worked. He formed. He filled. He made. Then He rested. He stopped. He ceased. He blessed the seventh day. He made it holy. He created a rhythm. He created a code. Work and rest. Labor and cease. Create and enjoy.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest." - Matthew 11:28


Jesus is the rest. He is the true rest. He is the one who gives rest to the weary. The rest in Genesis is a shadow. It is a clue. It is a code. The reality is Jesus.


The Verdict

The Resonance

"Now the LORD God had planted a garden in the east, in Eden; and there he put the man he had formed. The LORD God made all kinds of trees grow out of the ground—trees that were pleasing to the eye and good for food. In the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil." - Genesis 2:8-9 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God planted a garden. He planted it in Eden. He put the man there. He made trees grow. Trees that were pleasing to the eye. Trees that were good for food. In the middle of the garden was the tree of life. In the middle of the garden was the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. It was a place of beauty. It was a place of choice. It was a place of codes.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"Then Jesus said to them, 'Very truly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in you. Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.'" - John 6:53-54


Jesus is the tree of life. He is the one who gives eternal life. The garden in Genesis is a shadow. It is a clue. It is a code. The reality is Jesus.


The Verdict
The code of the garden is Jesus. The pattern is exact. The code is precise. The truth is Jesus.


The Resonance

The Prayer

pages.body:
The Hook

"And the LORD God commanded the man, 'You are free to eat from any tree in the garden; but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, for when you eat from it you will certainly die.'" - Genesis 2:16-17 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God gave a command. He gave a rule. He gave a test. He said, "You are free to eat from any tree. But you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. For when you eat from it, you will certainly die." It was a command. It was a boundary. It was a code.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous." - Romans 5:19


Adam disobeyed. He broke the command. He ate the fruit. He brought sin into the world. But Jesus obeyed. He kept the command. He never sinned. He brought righteousness into the world. The command in Genesis is a shadow. It is a clue. It is a code. The reality is Jesus.


The Verdict
The code of the command is Jesus. The pattern is exact. The code is precise. The truth is Jesus.


The Resonance
Do you feel like you are always breaking the rules? Do you feel like you are always failing? Do you feel like you are always disobeying? Remember Jesus. He obeyed for you. He kept the command for you. He brought righteousness for you.


The Prayer

God said, "It is not good for the man to be alone." He said, "I will make a helper suitable for him." He created the woman. He created Eve. He created a companion. He created a helper. He created a partner. It was a gift. It was a code.

pages.title: Day 14: The Code of the Helper

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Hook
Have you ever seen a code in a rib? Have you ever seen a code in a bone? Have you ever seen a code in a body? The book of Genesis tells a strange story. It tells a story about a rib. It tells a story about a bone. It tells a story about a woman. And the rib is a symbol. It is a truth. And it points to Jesus.


The Ancient Text (OT)
"But for Adam no suitable helper was found. So the LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep; and while he was sleeping, he took one of the man's ribs and then closed up the place with flesh. Then the LORD God made a woman from the rib he had taken out of the man, and he brought her to the man." - Genesis 2:20-22 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God caused Adam to fall into a deep sleep. He took a rib. He made a woman. He brought her to the man. It was a strange story. It was a beautiful story. It was a code. It pointed to something greater.


The Fulfillment (NT)
"For we are members of his body. 'For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.' This is a profound mystery—but I am talking about Christ and the church." - Ephesians 5:30-32


Paul says something amazing. He says the story of Adam and Eve is a mystery. He says it is about Christ and the church. Jesus slept in death. He took a wound in his side. He created the church. The rib in Genesis is a shadow. It is a clue. It is a code. The reality is Jesus.


The Verdict
The code of the rib is Jesus. The pattern is exact. The code is precise. The truth is Jesus.


The Resonance
Do you feel like you are a part of something? Do you feel like you belong? Remember the rib. Remember the church. You are part of the body of Christ. You are created from his side. You belong to him.


The Prayer
Jesus, thank you for the church. Thank you for creating the church. Thank you for the wound in your side. Thank you for the blood and water that flowed. Thank you for making me part of your body. Help me to love the church. Help me to serve the church. Help me to be the church. Amen.

END MATTER


The 30-Day Code Challenge
You have journeyed through 30 symbols in Genesis. Now what? I challenge you to read the Gospel of John. It is 21 chapters. It is the perfect follow-up to this book. It starts with the same words as Genesis. "In the beginning." It will show you how Jesus is the fulfillment of every symbol. As you read, look for the codes. Look for the clues. Look for Jesus.


A Note on Faith
The symbols are evidence. They are evidence of a divine plan. But evidence does not save you. The symbols point to a person. The symbols point to Jesus. You can understand the symbols and still miss the truth. The invitation is for your heart. Jesus said, "Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in." The symbols are on the table. The door is open. It is your choice.


About the Author
Christine A. writes for the spiritually curious. He is passionate about showing people the hidden wisdom of the Bible. He lives with his family and enjoys good coffee and long conversations with skeptics. He believes that honest questions deserve honest answers.
